description: The line plot illustrates the MRR@10 (Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10) performance of different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) variants as a function of the number of queries used during inference, ranging from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)," is a linear scale with integer values from 1 to 10. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10," is a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.5. Four distinct lines represent different experimental configurations: a black solid line labeled "DPR w/o query" remains constant at approximately 34.0 across all query counts; a red solid line with circular markers labeled "DPR w/ corpus expansion" starts at approximately 35.1 and increases to about 35.8; a green solid line with triangular markers labeled "DPR w/ document expansion" begins at around 34.6 and slightly decreases to about 34.7; and a blue solid line with star markers labeled "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" starts at approximately 34.6, peaks at around 34.9 at 2 queries, and then gradually declines to about 34.3 at 10 queries.
